trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary:

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed to all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was failing health checks with an 18% error rate. The most recent version healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken:**
1. ✅ Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0
2. ✅ Verified recovery — service is now healthy with error rate down to 0.2%
3. ✅ Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the failing deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0 across all regions, and verification of recovery

Note: the v2.3.1 deployment history also showed an unhealthy staging release (v2.3.1-rc), so the issue appears to be in the v2.3.1 codebase itself — the on-call engineer should investigate before it's re-deployed.
